author: SpicyTunaRoll9
body:
These are rare events that can be scarcely seen/done. If you do encounter one, consider yourself lucky.
1. Sfkwww defending.
2. Beat a hacker using killaura.
3. Yoavkipper with a shirt on.
4. A Notch apple in a nebula game.
5. A spanky spade donation to everyone in nexus.
6. An arrow shot from 100+ blocks away.
7. Howsie talking on teamspeak
8. IvyCode not being afk in the lobby.
9. Spleef 6+ people.
10. Be the first person to get punished by a newly promoted Jr. Mod.
